canonical_name: Incidents Not Escalated or Elevated as Needed
description: Incidents are not escalated or elevated as needed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with incident response capabilities Security operations and incident response teams Forensics and investigation functions Organizations with breach notification requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify high-severity incidents that remain at lower response tiers, critical events not reported to management or executive teams, incidents exceeding SLA thresholds without escalation, or missing escalation paths in incident workflows. Monitor for indicators that incident scope or impact has grown but response level has not adjusted accordingly.
